source.citation: [George M. Pullman residence, 1729 S. Prairie Avenue, completed.] Halftone of a photograph of the finished house from the south-west, across the crossing of Prairie Avenue and 18th Street; unknown photographer, undated (after the 1892 additions). Reproduced by the Glessner House Museum, 'Prairie Avenue in 1874' (blog, 2014-06-16).
what_it_supplies: a gas lamp post at the north-east corner of Prairie Avenue and 18th Street, in a curbed grass plot at the curb corner
a post fire hydrant on the Prairie Avenue parkway beside the walk, north of that corner
